baseline.definition: session baseline: landmarks returned when the active cephalometric analysis is loaded or freshly computed; it is not asserted to be the historical detector-original trace after a reopened corrected case
baseline.reset_behavior: create a new edit transaction from current landmarks to the session baseline; never delete or rewrite backend evidence history

frontend_bounds.note: frontend audit events are operational UX evidence only; persisted scientific audit remains backend evidence history

persistence.failure_behavior: surface sync error; do not claim persisted audit until server save succeeds
